name: Extreme heat
summary: No heatwave warning across a major region found on 26 Nov; Far North Queensland's heatwave ended on 19 Nov
state: Far North Queensland's severe heatwave ran to 19 Nov, with Weipa above 36°C for 41 straight days (The Watchers, 16 Nov). In the Philippines, PAGASA recorded danger-level heat index readings of 42–43°C in four areas on 7 Nov (GMA News). Searches on 26 Nov found no current heatwave warning across a major region, no new national record and no deadly heatwave, so Normal holds.
for_you: No action needed for most readers; in hot regions, follow national weather service heat advice.
rubric_hit: No heatwave warnings across a major region = Normal

sources.title: The Watchers — Weipa hits 41 straight days above 36°C as severe heatwave grips Far North Queensland
GMA News — At least 4 areas logged danger-level heat index on Nov 7, 2026

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
